content.class.new-watch.blurb: 你从荒原路来到格雷霍特接哨。随身只有自己的弓，别的几乎没带。
content.class.new-watch.kit.0.name: 你自己的弓
content.class.new-watch.name: 新守卫
content.dlg.ide.ide-farewell.opt.0.label: 一路平安
content.dlg.ide.ide-farewell.text: 不用，留着吧。剑是哨位的，你们就是哨位。黄昏记得点灯。天黑前我就到山谷了。
content.dlg.ide.ide-handover.opt.0.label: 我们去拿。
content.dlg.ide.ide-handover.opt.1.label: 哪一把？
content.dlg.ide.ide-handover.text: 那就按规矩办。哨位跟着它的剑走，剑就在我身后军械库的架子上。拿到这儿来，我当面交给你们。里面别的东西都归守卫，现在你们就是守卫。
content.dlg.ide.ide-hello.opt.0.label: 我们来接替。
content.dlg.ide.ide-hello.opt.1.label: 格雷霍特是哪儿？
content.dlg.ide.ide-hello.opt.2.label: 剑在哪？
content.dlg.ide.ide-hello.text: 你们就是新来的守卫吧。好。开春化冻起，我的行囊就搁在门边了。
content.dlg.ide.ide-post.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.ide.ide-post.text: 山头上的哨所。一盏灯，一本日志，一把剑。谁从荒原路上来，谁没来，都记下来。我记了三十个冬天。
content.dlg.ide.ide-return.opt.0.label: 剑在这儿。
content.dlg.ide.ide-return.text: 就是这把。剑柄都被我的手磨光了。
content.dlg.ide.ide-where.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.ide.ide-where.text: 进那扇门。架子上立着三个盔甲架，剑在中间那个上。
content.loot.the-moor-map.item.0.name: 荒原路地图
content.loot.the-watch-helmet.item.0.name: 守卫头盔
content.loot.the-watch-shield.item.0.name: 守卫盾牌
content.npc.ide.name: 艾德·芬威克
content.obj.the-post-sword.bring-the-sword.hint: 把剑带到院子里，交给军械库门旁的艾德。
content.obj.the-post-sword.bring-the-sword.title: 把剑交给艾德
content.obj.the-post-sword.meet-the-warden.hint: 她在院子对面的军械库门旁等着。
content.obj.the-post-sword.meet-the-warden.title: 去见哨长
content.obj.the-post-sword.take-the-sword.hint: 进军械库的门，剑在架子中间那个盔甲架上。
content.obj.the-post-sword.take-the-sword.title: 取走哨位之剑
content.quest.the-post-sword.goal: 在格雷霍特的院子里与哨长见面，从军械库的架子上取走哨位之剑，带出来交给她，好让她移交哨所。
content.world.outro: 艾德·芬威克背着行囊沿荒原路下山去了。现在格雷霍特的哨所归你了。
content.world.title: 军械库

source.class.new-watch.blurb: You came up the moor road to stand the watch at Greyholt. You brought your bow and not much else.
source.class.new-watch.kit.0.name: Your own bow
source.class.new-watch.name: New Watch
source.dlg.ide.ide-farewell.opt.0.label: Safe road.
source.dlg.ide.ide-farewell.text: No. Keep it. It's the post's, and you're the post. Light the lamp at dusk. I'll be in the valley by dark.
source.dlg.ide.ide-handover.opt.0.label: We'll bring it.
source.dlg.ide.ide-handover.opt.1.label: Which one is it?
source.dlg.ide.ide-handover.text: Then it's done properly. The post goes with its sword, and the sword is on the rack in the armoury, behind me. Bring it out here and I'll give it over. The rest in there is the watch's, and the watch is you now.
source.dlg.ide.ide-hello.opt.0.label: We're your relief.
source.dlg.ide.ide-hello.opt.1.label: What is Greyholt?
source.dlg.ide.ide-hello.opt.2.label: Where's the sword?
source.dlg.ide.ide-hello.text: You'll be the new watch. Good. I've had my pack by the door since the thaw.
source.dlg.ide.ide-post.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.ide.ide-post.text: A watch-house on the top. One lamp, one log, one sword. You write down who comes over the moor road and who doesn't. Thirty winters I've written it.
source.dlg.ide.ide-return.opt.0.label: Here it is.
source.dlg.ide.ide-return.text: That's the one. My hand wore the grip smooth.
source.dlg.ide.ide-where.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.ide.ide-where.text: Through that door. Three stands on the rack. The sword is on the middle one.
source.loot.the-moor-map.item.0.name: Map of the moor road
source.loot.the-watch-helmet.item.0.name: Watch helmet
source.loot.the-watch-shield.item.0.name: Watch shield
source.npc.ide.name: Ide Fenwick
source.obj.the-post-sword.bring-the-sword.hint: Carry it out to Ide, beside the armoury door in the yard.
source.obj.the-post-sword.bring-the-sword.title: Bring the sword to Ide
source.obj.the-post-sword.meet-the-warden.hint: She is waiting beside the armoury door, across the yard.
source.obj.the-post-sword.meet-the-warden.title: Meet the warden
source.obj.the-post-sword.take-the-sword.hint: Through the armoury door, on the middle stand of the rack.
source.obj.the-post-sword.take-the-sword.title: Take the post sword
source.quest.the-post-sword.goal: Meet the warden in the yard at Greyholt, take the post sword from the rack in the armoury, and bring it out to her so she can hand the watch-house over.
source.world.outro: Ide Fenwick goes down the moor road with her pack on her back. The watch-house at Greyholt is yours now.
source.world.title: The Armoury
